newsitem.title: CHINA: China smelter sees H1 copper output 24,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China smelter sees H1 copper output 24,000 tonnes.

text.p: China's Shenyang Smelter estimates production at 24,000 tonnes of electrolytic copper in the first half, roughly similar to the year-ago level, a company official said on Thursday.
The smelter, a unit of the China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corp, has annual capacity to produce 60,000 tonnes of copper cathodes and 100,000 tonnes of lead.
"Some of our products were exported," the official said by telephone from Shenyang, capital of the northeastern province of Liaoning. He declined to give export figures.
The plant was estimated to have turned out 27,000 tonnes of electrolytic lead in the first half, a rise of about 1,000 tonnes compared with the same period last year, he said.
The smelter also produces zinc and bismuth, he said, but declined to give further details.
